GAB.note: The document describes number enrolment and the card, with no authentication service.
No link between civil register and ID system is stated.
Enrolment has just begun and no count of people is given.
The NIP is given to citizens aged 16, not at birth.
The document does not say who builds or maintains the system.
No public register keyed on the NIP is stated.

facts.fact: The Interior Ministry says it launched on 3 April 2024 the issue of a 14-character Numero d'Identification Personnel to each citizen after biometric enrolment, under law 027/2020, ahead of the electronic ID card.
